_comment: Unattended local-endpoint declaration. The /localllm TUI wizard cannot run
without a UI, so an in-container pi needs this file.
Per docs/models.md: compatibility settings must describe VERIFIED differences
in the endpoint's behaviour. Nothing is enabled optimistically here — no
compat block, no modelOverrides, no thinking format. Populate those only after
brief 02 has probed the real server and recorded what it actually does.
Also: 'Model names are not facts.' The model ids below are placeholders for
whatever oMLX actually reports on /v1/models. Do not attribute a capability
to a name without probing it.
